motion_rule: he never stops: he swings hand over hand along a market rail racing at the lens, the camera racing backwards ahead of him so the stalls tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; head half the frame, from 7.1 a low angle, head in the bottom half, risen pan high in frame; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; camera move every beat
character: a lean brown macaque in a grey waistcoat, deadpan
second_characters: ONE small macaque porter in a green visor on the rail behind him
props: ONE brass balance beam with two identical pans, hooked on his tail; two identical brown coconuts, same size and husk, riding in his waistcoat
prop_continuity: the left pan hangs dead down from 1.0, the right pan rides up from 4.3 and never comes back down; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a packed bazaar lane, stalls of fruit and brass to the ceiling both sides, the rail racing over
light_events: hard noon sun bars strobe his face every beat, cold rim both sides

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: o-DIN, po-KA-zy-va-et, na-kop-LE-ni-ya, dru-GOY, kar-MI-che-ski-e, DOL-gi
audio.pacing: 0.45-3.55 one breath; pause to 5.05; 5.05-7.6 one breath; after 7.6 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: the rail singing, the bazaar roaring, a woody knock at 0.45, a brass chain slam at 1.0, a rising ring at 4.3

timeline.a: the brass beam swings into the lens off his tail, pans dead level, he is already swinging hand over hand, stalls tearing past
he swings on one arm and drops the first coconut into the left pan
he swings on hand over hand as the left pan slams down its chain and slings him along, stalls streaking
he swings past the loaded pan hanging dead down, the coconut sunk in it
he hauls himself along the rail, the loaded pan swinging under him, stalls tearing
he drops the other coconut into the right pan the same way, off one arm
he swings on as the right pan flies up past his ear and its coconut lifts off and floats
he swings on, the floating coconut riding above his shoulder
he bats at the floating coconut and it does not come down
the risen pan tows him off the rail and he swings from it, stalls streaking
he sails on under the risen pan, the sunk one swinging at his ear, the lane streaming under
the porter swings off the risen pan onto his shoulders, the lane streaming under
he swats the floating coconut back into the risen pan without slowing, lane racing
he swings the sunk pan past the lens, its coconut riding low, the risen one overhead
he throws himself into the lens, deadpan, the sunk pan at his ear and the risen pan overhead

must_appear: two identical coconuts; the first drops into the left pan at 0.45 and it slams down; the same drop into the right pan at 3.55 sends it up at 4.3, its coconut floating off; at 9.55 his deadpan face is in the lens, the sunk pan at his ear and the risen pan overhead, one identical coconut in each
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, two characters moving at once, a third coconut in frame, more than two pans, a third arm, a parked camera, a still background, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, cyrillic letters, readable text, a glowing emblem, extra limbs
